Dashboard Fixes, Built

7 Oct 2026, desktop at 1440px, branch feat/dbim-and-proposed-default (committed, not yet pushed). Every "After" is a screenshot of the running build. The "Before" pictures are the screens as they were this morning. Illustrative marks stay off by default, as you asked. The Figma handoff follows.

BuiltDashboard overview

The landing page: Department and Portal Dashboards

Before: the Department's education detail took about 2,900px before the first portal card. After: the headline figures, one card per Department and portal, then States/UTs. The page went from about 5,400px to about 3,600px. Nothing was removed; the detail moved one click in.

BuiltDepartment and Portal Dashboards

Portal cards titled by the portal

Your question: the cards were titled by the scheme (DAPSC, SHRESHTA) and named the portal in small type underneath. Now the portal leads (e-Utthaan, e-Anudaan, NMBA Portal, SMILE-Beggary Admin Portal, Senior Citizens Portal), with its scheme underneath. The Department's card joins the second row beside e-Utthaan's, so every row holds two cards of about one height. Each card's link reads 'View Dashboard', and a screen reader hears which portal's.

Built?programme=department (new)

The Department's own dashboard page

Your question: where does the education detail go? To the Department's own page, opened from its card. These figures are the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment's Beneficiary Dashboard: the hand-maintained page at dosje.gov.in/dashboard, read on 5 Oct 2026. They belong to no portal, and not to the whole Ministry, whose other Department publishes none of them. The page holds Scholarships and Fellowship, Hostels and Top Class Education, and one Year by Year Trends section. A new page has no before.

BuiltEvery portal page (SMILE shown)

Portal dashboard head, without repetition

Removed: the kicker that repeated the title, the four figures repeated in the cards directly below, 'N public indicators' (the theme chips show it), and the portal's name said twice. Kept: whose dashboard (the portal leads), the scheme, one sentence on what it does, the period, the body that runs it where that isn't the Department, and Open Portal. The way back now sits above the area bar, and 'Figures for' names only the area.

BuiltNMBA

The same head on NMBA, with its figures level

In a row where any label wraps, every label now holds as many lines as the longest, so all six figures start on one line.

BuiltOfficer Login

Officer Login: User ID and password only

Your instruction: two roles, Public and Officer. Signing in decides the role, and the account decides the scope. Tested: an unknown User ID gets 'The User ID or password is incorrect.' sd.bureau signs in as the Social Defence Division and sees NMBA and SMILE, All India.

BuiltDemo rail › Dashboard tab

Demo rail: accounts, not a role picker

The six-role 'View the Dashboard as' list is gone. The tab lists the prototype's demo User IDs, with what each account sees, and signs out. The password is not checked in this prototype.
